settings: Filtered sampling, no supersampling; authored preset controls.

metadata.source: Selected procedural source only; downstream graph operations are not included.
metadata.encoding: Linear unsigned 16-bit grayscale. value = valueMin + sample / 65535 * (valueMax - valueMin). Constant maps decode to valueMin.
metadata.units: Scalar output including amplitude and elevation offset; multiply by heightScaleMeters for meters.
metadata.orientation: Row-major; first row north (negative Z), X increases east. Samples include both tile endpoints.
